game.title: Kansas City Chiefs at Denver Broncos

lede: Kansas City Chiefs carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#10 in EPA per play), while Denver Broncos owns the more favourable defensive matchup (#5 in EPA allowed per play).
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Denver Broncos −1.0 with a fair total of 39.5 — approximately a one-score game, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Kansas City Chiefs pass offence vs Denver Broncos pass defence, which sits −0.178 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is quarterback information: Kansas City Chiefs and Denver Broncos have no confirmed starter on file, which materially affects how much confidence the exact number deserves.
